title: bee close: a blocking uat door under uat_stop close
action: The close side of CONTEXT.md D4.4 and D2. Add a new blocking uat door to the bee close driver, built and ordered beside the existing judge-debt door — that door is the precedent to copy in every structural respect: lane-scoped, blocking, escapable by a deferral decision. The door is PRESENT ONLY under crate::uat::UatStop::Close; under Merge and Off it does not appear in the door list at all (under Merge the stop already happened at merge time; under Off there is no stop). A None from uat_stop_config makes the door block with an invalid-config detail naming both keys and their legal values, rather than guessing. It BLOCKS when crate::uat::uat_gate_applies_to_lane says this feature's lane cares (standard and high-risk; tiny, small, docs, spike exempt; missing or unknown fails closed as standard) AND the uat gate is not approved. Read the gate exactly the way the merge-side precheck does — the live workflow record's own gates.uat.approved first, falling back to the default state record's approved_gates.uat ONLY when that record is still tracking this same feature. It is escapable by a uat-deferral decision naming the feature, mirroring how judge-debt accepts its judge-deferral decision. The blocking detail line names the remedy in the user's own terms: the product is on main, reload and test it, then bee gate --name uat --approved true — or fix in the worktree and merge again. Do not mention bee internals the user does not need. Add tests beside the existing close-door tests covering: door absent under merge and under off; door present and blocking under close for a standard lane with uat unapproved; not blocking under close once uat is approved; not blocking under close for a tiny, small, docs, or spike lane; blocking with the invalid-config detail when uat_stop holds a bogus value; and cleared by a uat-deferral decision naming the feature. Do NOT touch any other door, and do NOT touch the doc-deferral door — it has a known unrelated defect already filed in the backlog.
done_when: bee close carries a uat door that exists only under uat_stop close; it blocks a standard or high-risk feature whose uat gate is unapproved, passes once approved, is exempt for tiny, small, docs, and spike, is cleared by a uat-deferral decision, and reports an invalid-config detail rather than guessing on a bogus value. Every other door is untouched and the close suite is green.
notes: Phase 2. Depends on usp-1's crate::uat. Files are disjoint from usp-2 — the two run concurrently.

truths: The uat door does not appear at all under uat_stop merge or off.
Under close it blocks a standard or high-risk feature whose uat gate is unapproved.
Under close it passes once the uat gate is approved.
Under close it is exempt for tiny, small, docs, and spike, the same lane rule the merge side uses.
A uat-deferral decision naming the feature clears it, mirroring judge-debt.
A bogus uat_stop value blocks with an invalid-config detail rather than resolving either way.
No other close door changes behavior.
